title: Can Large Language Models Explain Flight Safety Events? A Prior-Guided Semantic LLM-based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.18017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving flight safety with flight data requires not only accurate detection of risk events, but more importantly, clear interpretation of their underlying causes at the level of pilot control behavior. Existing explainable AI techniques, such as feature importance maps, often require considerable domain knowledge to translate them into operationally meaningful explanations. Large Language Models (LLMs), which excel at language reasoning, bring a promising solution to this issue. However, applying LLMs in this domain presents key challenges such as modal inconsistency, limited classification ability, scarcity of task-specific data for fine-tuning, and lack of domain knowledge. translated_title: 大型语言模型能否解释飞行安全事件？一种先验引导的基于语义的大语言模型方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18017v1 公告类型：新 摘要：利用飞行数据提升飞行安全不仅需要准确检测风险事件，更重要的是在飞行员控制行为层面清晰解读其根本原因。现有的可解释人工智能技术，如特征重要性图，通常需要大量领域知识才能将其转化为具有操作意义的解释。擅长语言推理的大型语言模型（LLMs）为解决此问题带来了有前景的方案。然而，在该领域应用LLMs面临关键挑战，包括模态不一致、分类能力有限、用于微调的任务特定数据稀缺以及缺乏领域知识。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了FlightLLM，一种先验引导的基于语义的大语言模型方法，用于可解释的飞行安全分析。具体而言，我们首先进行特征工程以解决模态不一致问题，将统计描述符与生理特征相结合。
tldr: 本文提出FlightLLM方法，通过先验引导和语义特征工程，利用大型语言模型克服模态不一致等挑战，实现飞行安全事件的可解释性分析，无需大量微调数据即可提供操作层面的因果解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FlightLLM, a prior-guided semantic LLM-based approach that overcomes challenges like modal inconsistency to enable interpretable flight safety analysis, providing operationally meaningful causal explanations without extensive fine-tuning data.
